'''Kensaric''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Kensaric served as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and field tracker at the Alliance's [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. One [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|later]], Kensaric, by then a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]], participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] as a member of a [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] sent to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] to destroy the [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|SLD-26 planetary shield generator]] protecting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. During the battle, Kensaric was a scout responsible for covering the strike team's tracks. The strike team was able to successfully destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], allowing the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to destroy the unprotected [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].

==Biography==
===Battle of Hoth and preparing for the Battle of Endor===
{{Quote|We have stolen a small Imperial shuttle. Disguised as a cargo ship and using a secret Imperial code, a strike team will land on the moon and deactivate the shield generator.|General Crix Madine, outlining the strike team's role in the Endor mission|audio=Madine-Imperialshuttlestolen.flac|<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CCG" /> Kensaric served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|212|Kensaric, Corporal}}</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="FF Hoth">{{FactFile|44|LEI 13-16|Princess Leia Organa}}</ref> Kensaric was stationed in [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]],<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command's]] headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]],<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> serving as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and a field tracker under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]].<ref name="CSWE" /> That year,<ref name="FF Hoth" /> Kensaric participated in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="CSWE" /> during which the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered and initiated a [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground assault]] on the Rebel base, ultimately forcing the Alliance to abandon the planet.<ref name="ESB" /> Kensaric was able to survive the Alliance's staggering defeat.<ref name="CSWE" />

[[File:Brenderlin.jpg|thumb|left|Major Bren Derlin, Kensaric's commanding officer on Hoth]]
By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], one year after the Battle of Hoth, Kensaric had become a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]]. That year,<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|44|END 11-14|The Battle of Endor}}</ref> the Alliance discovered that the Empire was constructing a [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. A [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was organized to infiltrate the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and destroy the [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|SLD-26 planetary shield generator]] protecting the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The strike team, made up of volunteers, was chosen from men who had previously served at Hoth. Solo contacted Derlin, and the strike team was shortly afterward assembled.<ref name="mts">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> Kensaric was a member of the strike team, serving as a scout responsible for covering the team's tracks.<ref name="CCG" />

Kensaric<ref name="CCG" /> and the rest of the strike team traveled to the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] aboard the stolen Imperial [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']], flown by Solo and his co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Although they were queried by the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], the use of a stolen Imperial clearance code gave the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] clearance to land at their destination. Upon landing on Endor, the strike team began scouting the area. They eventually spotted a [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] patrol consisting of Corporal [[Avarik]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Elsek]], and Solo's failed attempt to stealthily ambush the pair caused a skirmish that alerted more scout [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to the strike team's presence.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Battle of Endor and Alliance victory===
{{Quote|Take the squad ahead. We'll meet at the shield generator at 0300.|General Han Solo, to Major Bren Derlin|audio=SoloDerlin.flac|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
Their position compromised, two other members of the strike team's command crew, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], mounted Avarik's [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]] and gave chase to the remaining scouts. The strike team waited until only Skywalker returned. Upon realizing that Organa was missing, having been separated from Skywalker during the [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] chase, Solo led the rest of the command crew to search for her, giving the strike team orders to continue on their path until a rendezvous at the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] at 0300 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Led by Derlin,<ref name="Night Attack">{{WEGCite|story=Night Attack|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi}}</ref> Kensaric<ref name="CCG" /> and the rest of the squad made its way toward the shield generator. Although the squad managed to hide from several encounters with Imperial patrols, Corporal [[Delevar]], the team's [[Medic/Legends|medic]], almost compromised their position by preparing to take a potshot at a speeder bike, to which Derlin subsequently reprimanded him.<ref name="Night Attack" />

[[File:AT-ST_negvv.png|thumb|right|200px|Kensaric and the others in the strike team disabled an All Terrain Scout Transport (pictured).]]
Kensaric<ref name="CCG" /> and the squad set up camp in a camouflaged shallow ravine at nightfall, posting two sentries and setting up a [[blanket grid]] with their scanning equipment. Shortly after their first [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] shift, the scanners picked up an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] coming towards their location. When it became clear that the walker would not pass them by, Corporal [[Dansra Beezer]] jammed its transmissions. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Greeve (Human)|Greeve]] destroyed both spotlights with<ref name="Night Attack" /> his [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]],<ref name="Endor-A280">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=A280 Sharpshooter Rifle}}</ref> and the squad circled the walker to keep it off balance. When the AT-ST began firing randomly into the trees and foliage, Delevar fired a [[Smoke canister/Legends|smoke canister]] into its [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]. The resulting explosion forced the walker pilots to abandon the vehicle and surrender to the strike team. The squad captured the pilots and, holding them at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]], forced them to make a comm check-in. As the squad continued on to the rendezvous point, they forced the pilot to make several more check-ins on the way to explain the walker's absence.<ref name="Night Attack" />

[[File:EndorBunker-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|The back door of the shield generator bunker on Endor]]
By the time of the reunion, Solo and his companions had befriended the moon's [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] tribe of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]. The Ewoks showed the strike team a route to the [[Endor shield generator bunker]]'s backdoor. Four scout troopers guarded the entrance; however, one of the Ewok scouts, [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], stole one of the scouts' speeder bikes, prompting three of them to give chase. Solo lured the remaining scout to the waiting strike team, who took him captive and made their way into the bunker, intending to destroy it with [[7-PrG proton grenade/Legends|7-PrG proton grenades]]. However, they were soon ambushed by [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]], the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Legion/Legends|legion]] stationed on Endor, and led outside the bunker.<ref name="ROTJ" />

The strike team's capture was short-lived, as the Ewoks launched a counterattack on the Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]], turning the tide of the battle in favor of the Alliance. Eventually, Chewbacca hijacked one of the AT-ST walkers, [[Tempest Scout 2/Legends|Tempest Scout 2]]. Solo decided to mount the walker, and, donning an [[Vehicle Command Crewer|AT-ST driver's]] [[Armor/Legends|helmet]], used the walker's communication system to give a fake Imperial victory message to the bunker, once more getting the doors opened. Regaining access to the bunker, the strike team managed to successfully destroy the shield generator with their [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenades]], allowing the Alliance Fleet's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to enter the unprotected Death Star and destroy its [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|reactor core]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Kensaric was light-skinned with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="CCG" />

==Equipment==
Kensaric and the rest of the Endor strike team were equipped with basic commando gear, which included a standard [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a low-feedback scanner, a [[Sensor scrambler (equipment)|sensor scrambler]], a [[Sound suppressor|heavily muffled]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and full-[[Forest/Legends|forest]]-camouflage [[Alliance military uniform/Legends|fatigues]].<ref name="GG5">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kensaric appeared in promotional photos for [[1983]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> with the character ultimately not appearing in the final film.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The photos, which appear in [[1998]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' CD-ROM, show Kensaric standing in the second Death Star's corridors alongside Luke Skywalker and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="BtM" /> Although not credited, Kensaric was portrayed by [[Paul Weston]].<ref name="Aficionado">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2010/09/classic-image-rebel-assembly.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=CLASSIC IMAGE: REBEL ASSEMBLY!}}</ref> Kensaric was first identified by name and given a brief backstory on a card for the [[June]] [[1999]] ''[[Endor Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" />
